valuation.method: Bank: tangible net asset value (TNAV) per ordinary share projected to the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) x P/TNAV, converted to the NYSE ADR at 1 ADR = 5 ordinary shares (ADR ratio from memory of the HSBC/BNY Mellon program; confirm on the depositary page). HSBC reports in USD, so no FX is needed for the valuation itself: Q3 2026 TNAV $9.41 per ordinary share ($47.05 per ADR; 6-K of 2026-10-27). Base grows TNAV about 6% to $9.95 by Nov 2027 (RoTE 17%+ target, 50% payout, ongoing $1bn buybacks, CET1 13.9% vs 14-14.5% target). Steady-state check P/TNAV = (RoTE 17% - g 4%)/(COE 11% - 4%) = 1.86x, so base uses 1.85x. Cross-check: $18.41 per ordinary share is about 10.3x model FY2027 EPS of about $1.78 (9M26 diluted EPS $1.26; assumption, not guidance). Analyst targets are published in GBp for the London line; converted per ADR as GBp/100 x 5 x GBP/USD 1.323 (approximate Nov 13 2026 level, ~1.322-1.323 intraday; not an official close). Same conversion applied to each prior target.

bear.driver: Credit costs run above the 45bp 2026 guide, Hong Kong property and rate pressure cut RoTE to about 12%, buybacks pause and CET1 stays below range; TNAV about flat.
bear.assumption: TNAV $9.60 per ordinary share at 1.40x P/TNAV = $13.44, x5 per ADR

base.driver: Banking NII of at least $46bn, cost growth about 1%, RoTE about 17-18% as targeted, 50% payout plus $1bn-a-quarter style buybacks keep TNAV compounding about 6%.
base.assumption: TNAV $9.95 per ordinary share at 1.85x P/TNAV = $18.41, x5 per ADR

bull.driver: Wealth and fee income re-accelerate, RoTE above 19%, ECL normalises to the 30-40bp range and capital return steps up; TNAV compounds about 9%.
bull.assumption: TNAV $10.30 per ordinary share at 2.20x P/TNAV = $22.66, x5 per ADR

valuation.implied_by_close: The close of $89.62 ($17.92 per ordinary share) is 1.90x Q3 TNAV of $9.41 and 1.80x base Nov 2027 TNAV of $9.95. The equal-weight named target of about $100.6 per ADR ($20.12 per share) implies 2.02x base TNAV, or TNAV of about $10.88 at a constant 1.85x.
valuation.sensitivity: 0.1x of P/TNAV moves the base target by $4.98 per ADR (5.6 pp of price return); $0.10 of TNAV per ordinary share moves it by $0.93 (1.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: RoTE excluding notable items (base needs 17% or better), TNAV per share growth from $9.41, banking NII tracking the $46bn-plus guide, and ECL near 45bp of loans.
valuation.next_disclosure: FY2026 results, expected late February 2027 (date not confirmed; check the HSBC investor calendar).

analyst_notes: Ten named analysts were sourced from one TipRanks forecast table (retrieved 2026-11-18); nine updated on or after the Oct 27 Q3 release (Citi cut 1,640p to 1,420p, BofA cut 1,720p to 1,685p); Morgan Stanley (Aug 4, raised from 1,527p) is the only pre-earnings call. Converted at 1.323, named targets run from $74 (Jefferies) to $123 (Goldman) with an equal-weight mean of about $100.6, roughly 9.5 pp above the 2.7% base-case return; that is equal to about 2.02x versus 1.85x base TNAV, or TNAV near $10.9, though the analysts' assumptions are unknown. Horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target; all ten rows come from one aggregator, and Citic, Huatai, CICC, DBS and KBW rows were omitted (unnamed analyst, HK/other basis or older). GBp-to-USD conversion uses an approximate rate and the 1:5 ADR ratio.
